instrument: Zoning ordinance amendment defining data center, effective April 2 2014
summary: Data centers were treated as an office use in Loudoun County until a zoning ordinance amendment defining data center took effect on April 2, 2014.
notes: Bears on the definitional lane. Phoenix similarly had no definition and addressed data centers through informal interpretation before July 2025. In both cases a use was permitted for years under a classification written for something else.
confidence_note: The 2014 amendment has not been read and its case number is unknown. What office use permitted, and under what standards, is NOT_CHECKED.
